title: Dispatch RFU 8: The Returned Boy Knows a City Long Gone
summary: Officials search records for the household he remembers.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Jonah Marr recognizes the old street and his sister but knows nothing of the years since 1949. Mrs. Marr, now elderly, says she does not expect him to recognize her face. She has shown him the ring recovered from the cloud; he remembers helping their mother bury it.
The court has remained dry. Surveyors will leave the culvert open under a new grate. Dr. Saye has retained the red soil and shells, whose paths through the rising water remain unexplained.
